opening: {school_name}'s gym is quiet. A new season is about to begin.
title: HOOPS MANAGER: ROAD TO STATE

sections.heading: YOU ARE THE HEAD COACH
sections.text: Guide the entire basketball program through one season. You will not control individual plays. Your decisions before each game determine whether the team is prepared to win.

sections.heading: THE SEASON
sections.text: The regular season lasts seven games. Win at least four to qualify for the playoffs, then survive the semifinal and state final to become champion.

sections.heading: PLAN EACH WEEK
sections.text: Every week gives you a limited token budget and three moves. Spend them on focused training, team practice, recovery, team culture, recruiting, or banking emergency tokens. A balanced plan develops skill without exhausting the roster.

sections.heading: KNOW YOUR TEAM
sections.text: Shooting, defense, stamina, morale, fatigue, preparation, cohesion, and bench depth all influence the result. Choose a captain with strong leadership. The five best available athletes start automatically.

sections.heading: EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED
sections.text: Injuries, grades, transfer interest, and morale problems may interrupt the week. Every event offers choices. Paid responses can use weekly tokens or the reserve you built earlier.

sections.heading: LEARN FROM EVERY GAME
sections.text: After the final score, read Why This Happened. It identifies the three largest factors, athlete highlights, and a coaching tip. Use that evidence to improve next week's plan.

sections.heading: CONTROLS
sections.text: Use the mouse or Tab and arrow keys to move between buttons. Press Enter to select, Escape to go back, M to mute, and F on the weekly plan to fast-forward with confirmation. Display and accessibility options are available on the dashboard.

sections.heading: FIRST-SEASON ADVICE
sections.text: Choose Varsity difficulty. Watch fatigue, practice before difficult opponents, recover when the roster is tired, and save reserve tokens for emergencies. The full guide remains available under How to Play.

closing: THE PROGRAM IS YOURS. MAKE EVERY WEEK COUNT.
